title: GitHub owner sweep (#53)
description: List new next steps for open issues and PRs (owner + step per line), after applying ownership itself: assigns the login and labels agent:<id> / review:<reviewer>. Keeps its dedupe state in .agentx/owner-sweep/. Always exits 0; the first line is RESULT steps=<n> [applied=<m>] or RESULT error=<why>.
command: node scripts/owner-sweep.mjs --repo anis-marrouchi/agentx --state .agentx/owner-sweep/agentx.json --agent coder-agent --coordinator secretary-agent --assignee anis-marrouchi --owner coder-agent --reviewer devops-agent
